subject: RFI: SIG/ISO/SOC2 artifact request — Federated Care procurement
messages:
From: Lara Nguyen <lara.nguyen@federatedcare.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@federatedcare.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: RFI: SIG/ISO/SOC2 artifact request for procurement evaluation

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the onboarding call last week. Attached is Appendix B from our procurement RFP — the security questionnaire and the control list we need evidence for as part of our technical evaluation. High-level asks:

- Evidence mapping vs. SIG rows (we've highlighted ~42 controls that matter for our risk team, incl. A.8/A.9/A.10 from ISO and SOC2 CC6/CC7 patterns).
- Sample excerpts of audit logs (auth, KMS access events) for the last 90 days — redacted for PII/PHI where needed.
- KMS key rotation proof and policy excerpt.
- Network diagram showing segmentation for private deployments (we run PHI workloads; please call out where isolation lives).
- Statement of whether you will accept evidence via secure SFTP, or if you require a signed NDA/portal upload.

Our timeline is tight — procurement would like to make a short list by 2027-07-06. Can you confirm:
1) Whether you can deliver a consolidated evidence packet (PDF/CSV index + samples) by 2027-06-30, and
2) Any constraints for PHI-handling artifacts (do you require Private deployment or dedicated capacity to produce unredacted logs?).

I've attached the RFP appendix (FC-RFP-AppendixB-SIG-asks.pdf). Let me know if you want a 30-min walkthrough this week.

Thanks,
Lara Nguyen
RFP Coordinator, Federated Care
lara.nguyen@federatedcare.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachments: FC-RFP-AppendixB-SIG-asks.pdf (application/pdf, 142 KB)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Lara Nguyen <lara.nguyen@federatedcare.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 18:01:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: RFI: SIG/ISO/SOC2 artifact request for procurement evaluation

Hi Lara —

Appreciate the clear asks and the deadline. We can meet the short list timeline and will prepare a compact assurance packet targeted to the SIG rows you highlighted. Quick answers up front:

- Commitment: We can deliver a consolidated packet and index by 2027-06-30. The packet will include an evidence index (CSV), redaction guidance, and samples of logs/audit excerpts.
- PHI constraints: For unredacted, line-item PHI logs we strongly recommend Federated Care use Redwood Private or Redwood Dedicated for the scope of your production rollout. For procurement purposes we can provide redacted samples and KMS provenance from our hosted environment.
- Delivery method: We can upload to a secure SFTP location or share via a temporary, access-controlled intake portal. For legal/contract-inflight asks we can do a short NDA and a DocuSign cover sheet if you prefer.

Next steps I propose:
1) We’ll schedule a 30-minute evidence-handshake call — available 2027-06-19 between 14:00–17:00 PT. Please confirm a slot.
2) I’ll open an intake ticket and assemble a small artifact team: Kimberly (evidence curator) and Karthik (technical lead) will coordinate artifacts and redaction rules.

I’ve attached our intake instructions and the draft evidence-index template to speed review.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Manager, Assurance Programs
Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-assurance-intake-instructions.pdf (application/pdf, 98 KB), redwood-evidence-index.csv (text/csv, 6 KB)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 18:07:00 +00:00
Subject: Fwd: RFI: SIG/ISO/SOC2 artifact request — Federated Care procurement (action items)

Kimberly / Karthik —

Forwarding Federated Care's appendix and my reply. Action items below (deadline: packet ready 2027-06-30 EOD):

- Kimberly: curate a compact packet aligned to the FedCare SIG rows; create an evidence-index.csv mapping SIG IDs -> artifact filename -> redaction status. Include a short owner note per artifact.
- Karthik: tech clarifications — can we produce: 90-day auth/KMS audit excerpts (redacted), KMS key rotation ledger export, and a network segmentation diagram for Private/Dedicated? If any artifacts require us to request customer-specific permission/TEK or to stand up a dedicated capture, flag it here.
- Priya: coordinate SFTP intake and provide templated redaction guidance for FedCare.

Also note two subtle asks from the RFP: 1) they want evidence of KMS access events tied to principal identities (we may need to show a crosswalk between KMS logs and our identity provider events), and 2) they requested proof of vendor attestations for third-party libraries tied to ML model serving (we can reference our third-party inventory + vendor SOC reports).

I’ll be on the call if they book — otherwise I’ll do a final packet review before delivery.

— Priya

Priya / Kimberly —

Quick tech note and ETA for artifacts we can provide from our hosted environment this week:

Available (can be packaged by 2027-06-30):
- KMS key rotation ledger (export CSV showing key id, rotation timestamp, rotation actor) — redacted principal IDs where needed. Attachment stub: redwood-kms-rotation-2027Q2.csv
- Auth audit excerpt (90 days): login/sso success/fail events with IP, timestamp, obfuscated user-id (one-way hash) — sample file: redwood-authlog-sample-90d.txt
- SOC2 control mapping doc (narrative) that crosswalks Redwood controls to SIG rows — redwood-soc2-sig-crosswalk.pdf
- Third-party vendor list + links to attestation reports (we’ll include vendor SOC2/SOC3 pointers) — redwood-3p-inventory.pdf

Items that need an ask / additional step:
- Unredacted PHI-bearing logs: cannot supply from hosted environment. Recommend FedCare either: (a) accept redacted samples for procurement, or (b) request a short-lived export from their Private deployment (if they already pilot with us) or run under Redwood Dedicated with an agreed capture window.
- Network diagram for Private deployment: we have a canonical diagram; I’ll adapt to show VLAN/subnet isolation and where KMS/HSM sits. Attachment stub: redwood-private-network-diagram.pdf

Delivery options: we will upload a zipped packet to the SFTP path listed in the intake ticket and share time-limited credentials, or we can put artifacts in the intake portal link Priya created.

I’ll start assembling the packet and flag any artifacts that require legal review (e.g., vendor contractual excerpts).

— Karthik
